description: Black and white full-length portrait of Georgia O’Keeffe in the landscape standing on a desiccated mound at the Black Place framed by numerous white fluffy floating clouds. She stands in semi-profile with her hair pulled back wearing a black wrap dress, a silver beaded necklace and her Victor Aguilar black suede and silver belt and white sneakers. One hand is on her hip with the other gloved hand on her chest, her black Stetson hat hangs on her back.
title: O'Keeffe Walking at Black Place
